description: This file implements the response handling logic for FAPI P5 protocol messages, including parameter responses, configuration responses, stop indications, slot indications, and error indications. It manages transaction outcomes and enqueues tasks for asynchronous processing.

classes.name: p5_responses_handler
classes.description: A class responsible for handling responses and indications related to the P5 protocol in FAPI, managing transaction outcomes based on received messages.

methods.name: on_param_response
methods.description: Handles parameter response messages, setting transaction outcome based on success or failure.

methods.name: on_config_response
methods.description: Handles configuration response messages, resetting flags and setting transaction outcomes.

methods.name: on_stop_indication
methods.description: Handles stop indication messages, marking the stop response as successful.

methods.name: handle_slot_indication
methods.description: Processes slot indication messages, setting the start outcome once per transaction.

methods.name: on_error_indication
methods.description: Handles error indication messages, setting outcomes based on message type.
